facts.text: I've never had real food. Joi cooks dinner for me every night. It looks perfect. It just isn't there.
facts.why: Invented line signed Officer K. Deckard's real food line in the casino is 'Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.'
facts.fix: Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.

fix_note.text: Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.

facts.text: The small wooden horse K carves into his memory.
facts.why: K does not carve the horse. It is a memory (really Dr Stelline's) and he later finds the toy horse in the orphanage furnace where he remembers hiding it. The date 6.10.21 is carved on the tree.
facts.fix: The small wooden horse K remembers hiding in the orphanage furnace.

facts.text: Deckard pours one for the dog too.
facts.why: Deckard has a dog, but nothing I opened says he pours it a drink. 'Bad dog' is Luv's line to K.
facts.fix: Deckard keeps a dog and a bottle in the old casino.

facts.text: Joi, a hologram who cooks for him
facts.why: Joi is K's holographic girlfriend. No source I could open says she cooks for him.
facts.fix: Joi, the hologram who keeps him company

facts.text: Sapper's pot, still going on the stove.
facts.why: No source I opened shows a pot on Sapper Morton's stove.
facts.fix: Sapper Morton's farm, where K finds the buried box.

vibe.verdict: Strong dark neon look and the right farm and horse, but the food leans on a guessed Joi dinner and a made-up Deckard dog drink.
missing: K's baseline poem 'cells interlinked within cells interlinked' (the test)
Deckard dreaming of toasted cheese (Las Vegas casino)
Joi's emanator and the name Joe (K's apartment)
Sapper Morton: 'You've never seen a miracle' (the farm)
Wallace's synthetic farming empire and his blindness
Luv crying while she kills Lieutenant Joshi
ideas: Swap the Officer K note for Deckard's 'dream of cheese' line.
Swap the old fashioned note 'Deckard pours one for the dog too' for 'Deckard's bar in the empty casino, toasted cheese on the side'.
Swap 'Roasted garlic bulbs with sourdough' for 'Toasted cheese on sourdough' (Deckard's dream).
Swap the wooden horse note for the real memory of hiding it in the furnace.
